summary: Frontend-only verification of Blocco 1 (dual camera options everywhere) on mobile 430px as admin@mikilab.de (PRO). All 5 requested surfaces PASS: PhotoDiagnosi (photo-dual), ScanRecipe (scan-dual), AdattaForno Foto (adatta-dual), RecipeDialog (recipe-photo-take/attach), CapoLaboratorio (capo-film-start/capo-film-attach). In every case the 'Scatta ora' input carries capture='environment' and the 'Allega' input has NO capture attribute; setting a file on the gallery input drove the expected flow (preview + enabled analyze / scan-loading / AI result). SEPARATE CRITICAL PRE-EXISTING BUG FOUND: with lang='en' (the default in a browser whose locale is en-US, i.e. most first-time visitors) the app crashes with a red runtime overlay — 'Cannot destructure property encyclopedia of content[lang] as it is undefined' — because /app/frontend/src/data/content.js only defines 'it' and 'de'. This made Diagnosi (and News/Impara/Mikilab) completely unusable until localStorage mikilab_lang was forced to 'it'.

ui_bugs.issue: content object has only 'it' and 'de' keys. When lang==='en' (auto-detected from navigator.language in a fresh en-US browser) every `content[lang]` access throws: 'Cannot destructure property encyclopedia of content[lang] as it is undefined' -> full React crash overlay, Diagnosi screen unusable. Add an 'en' block or fall back: `const c = content[lang] || content.it`.

The 'Cambia foto' overlay button still opens the legacy camera-only input (photo-file-input / adatta-file-input with capture='environment'), i.e. a single camera-only path. The DualPhotoButtons block remains rendered above so the user is not blocked, but per the Blocco 1 directive this change-path should also offer 'Allega' (or the legacy inputs should be removed).

issues: Fixed floating 'Radio' (left) and 'Parla' (right) FABs overlap the primary CTA ('Analizza il forno' / 'Analizza') — the button's left and right ends are covered; center is still clickable. Same overlap previously reported for the recipe list (iteration_27).
Console warnings (non-blocking): repeated 'value prop on input should not be null' and a hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from a select in the recipes/App tree.

action_items: CRITICAL: guard/complete content[lang] (add 'en' data or fallback to content.it) — English-locale users get a white/red crash screen on Diagnosi, News, Impara and Mikilab.
Optional: make 'Cambia foto' respect the dual-option directive (or delete the legacy capture-only inputs photo-file-input / adatta-file-input).
Optional: fix null-valued controlled inputs and the <span> inside <option> nesting warning; review FAB overlap over primary CTAs.
critical_code_review_comments: data/content.js is indexed directly by lang in 6+ components with no fallback — a single missing locale key crashes the whole subtree. Centralise it in a `useContentData()` hook returning `content[lang] ?? content.it`.
DualPhotoButtons is correctly implemented (cam input capture='environment', gallery input without capture, e.target.value reset so re-picking the same file fires onChange) — no issues found.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 Blocco 1 items PASS; 1 unrelated critical crash found

seed_data_creation: none (no recipe saved; RecipeDialog only opened and inspected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation: intro-close-btn -> login-btn -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit. PRO tools are under nav-tab-maestro -> maestro-tool-scan / maestro-tool-adatta / maestro-tool-capo, back via maestro-back-btn. IMPORTANT: headless browsers resolve lang='en' which crashes the app; run `localStorage.setItem('mikilab_lang','it')` then reload before testing. Also note: uploading a file to scan-gallery-input completes the scan and auto-opens the RecipeDialog ('Modifica ricetta') whose overlay blocks all subsequent clicks — close it (Esc) before continuing. Verified attributes: photo/scan/adatta cam-input capture='environment', gallery-input capture=None; recipe-photo-take input capture='environment', recipe-photo-attach input capture=None; capo-film-attach input capture=None and attaching an image produced a real AI result in capo-film-result (~10s).
rca_of_the_issue: LanguageContext auto-detects 'en' from navigator.languages and persists it, but data/content.js exports only { it, de }. Components destructure content[lang] without a fallback, so the render throws a TypeError and React unmounts the tree (dev overlay shown). Fix in data access layer, not in the components.
